title: Musicians in Gabriel's Moulin Rouge group
summary: He names trumpeters, clarinetists and pianists he used at the Moulin Rouge, including Little Daddy.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: He worked with me also here at the Molen Rouge. I had him with me at one time. Oh, really? I had Manuel Krustow playing trumpet with me at one time. With Jack Lamont on clarinet. I had Hilde on trumpet with me at one time. As a matter of fact, I kept a good group of- Toots played piano with me after my brother went in service. Little Daddy played piano with me for a while there.
What was Little Daddy's brother's name? Which Little Daddy is this?
Little Daddy piano player, a little short fella. Last time I saw him, he was pretty sick. He could hardly walk. If I heard his name, I would know him.
